purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Githunguri Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, cropped around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation at 500 DPI. Cross-checked against this same page's own printed Aggregate Results table and the following page's Voter Turnout summary block (104,592 registered; 72,810 turned out; 70%), which reconciles exactly to Total Valid Votes + Rejected Ballots (72,338 + 472 = 72,810). The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (GITHUNGURI, code 116) was read from the visible 'CON 116' banner marker and the page's own 'Name of Constituency: GITHUNGURI / Code: 116' header block before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row, cross-checked against the form's own Aggregate Results table on the same page.

note: The printed Registered Voters figure (104,592) matches the governed P23 ward-summed registered-voters denominator (KDA-VOTERS-CON-116-2022) exactly, and the four candidate cells sum exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes. The form's own Voter Turnout summary block (page 5) independently confirms 72,810 total voters turned out (Total Valid Votes 72,338 + Rejected Ballots 472), a 70% turnout consistent with the printed figures. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
